observations: Component fixtures visibly show the Save subject, owned description and next After control in sparse fixture styling; they do not establish full production styling parity.

Both production screenshots show the Account tooltip and Web Components selector active. The original test takes its screenshot after switching from the initially requested React runtime to the replacement WC owner. They are replacement-owner screenshots, not initial React frames.
The first React focus, native Tab, Escape and replacement-owner evidence is supplied by each matching stage in the actual browser AX JSON, not inferred from the final image.

conclusion: The later actual source82/82, complete component-consumer84/84 and public Base Tooltip8/8 receipts support this exact reviewed Portal candidate within their named scopes, with no new technical finding.
